visual_standard.animal_anatomy: species-accurate anatomy, proportions, skin/fur/feather detail and natural movement
visual_standard.environment: physically plausible habitat, scale, weather, lighting and perspective
visual_standard.physics: credible water, reflections, refraction, shadows, contact, momentum and environmental interaction
visual_standard.camera: credible wildlife-documentary lensing, stable observational framing, restrained natural camera movement, realistic focus and exposure
visual_standard.motion: subtle, continuous, biologically plausible behavior; no morphing, jitter, teleporting or exaggerated action
visual_standard.color: restrained natural color grading; no fantasy lighting or oversaturation
visual_standard.audio: natural location ambience; narration and music only when separately approved and rights-cleared

mandatory_negative_checks: No impossible water or environmental physics
No implausible animal scale or behavior
No excessive sharpening, oversaturation or artificial cinematic effects
No text, logos or watermarks baked into raw footage
No AI-generated footage represented as genuine documentary footage

platform_delivery.facebook_reels: 9:16 vertical; platform-specific safe areas and captions checked
platform_delivery.youtube_shorts: 9:16 vertical; Shorts duration and safe areas checked
platform_delivery.youtube_long_form: 16:9 horizontal; 6-10 minutes unless an approved brief specifies otherwise

release_gate: Reject and regenerate or replace any shot that fails anatomy, physics, motion, camera, provenance, rights, or human-review checks. A generation-complete status is not a quality approval.
